name: Magical ☆ Dears
source:
Magician has always existed since ancient time. They never showed their true face to the public, but they are there bringing balance to the world and its history behind the shadow. However, with technology becoming more advanced and conflicts becoming more often, the magicians have no choice but to reveal themselves. 

It was shown that it was futile to oppose them, and magicians were viewed with disdain from the public. However, they showed that their power could bring fortune to people, and with a help from a certain incident, people began showing their support for them. Small areas for the magician to live was estabilished across the world. One of them is in Japan, and there stand a magic school called Arcadia 5.

Currently, the gender ratio of magicians has reached 10000:1 with male magicians nearing extinction. Tomohiro is one such male magician, raised under close watch apart from the outside world. However one day, the chairwoman of Arcadia 5 sent him an invitation to attend the magic school. So, he decided to go with his imouto Minazuki in order to see the outside world.

But he was the only boy at the school and curious eyes followed him whenever he went. Amidst this situation, he had two goals to achieve: to fall in love with someone and to become a great magician.

[Based on [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
魔术师自古以来就存在。他们从未向公众展示过自己的真面目，但他们为世界及其阴影背后的历史带来了平衡。然而，随着科技越来越发达，冲突越来越多，魔术师们别无选择，只能暴露自己的身份。

事实证明，反对他们是徒劳的，魔术师受到了公众的蔑视。然而，他们却展现出了自己的力量可以给人们带来财富，并且在某件事的帮助下，人们开始对他们表示支持。世界各地都建立了供魔术师居住的小区域。其中之一是在日本，有一所名为阿卡迪亚5的魔法学校。

目前，魔法师的性别比例已经达到10000：1，男性魔法师濒临灭绝。智宏就是这样一位男性魔法师，在远离外界的严密监视下长大。然而有一天，阿卡迪亚5的董事长向他发出了去魔法学校学习的邀请。于是，他决定和水无月一起去看看外面的世界。

但他是学校里唯一的男孩，每当他去的时候，好奇的目光都会跟着他。在这种情况下，他有两个目标要实现：爱上一个人，以及成为一名伟大的魔法师。

[基于 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
